Explore La Fora
Your journey starts here
There is an expression on Fogo, Cape Verde: higher is fresher.  La Fora Ecolodge is situated on the slopes of the Caldera above the noise and heat of Sao Filipe, a perfect start to your Fogo adventure.  Each room at La Fora Ecolodge is its own private bungalow with outdoor seating and ensuite bathroom.  Enjoy the privacy of your own bungalow, or get to know your fellow travelers at the open-air terrace bar and restaurant.
Sustainable Travel
La Fora Ecolodge is committed to sustainable travel.
At La Fora Ecolodge, we are committed to sustainable travel.  Sustainability animates and drives everything that we do, and we are working to not only maintain but improve our local environment through sustainable, ethical tourism.

Experience beautiful Fogo, Cape Verde from the heart of the countryside in a sustainability driven, eco-hotel.
La Fora Ecolodge is a sustainability-driven, ecologically-minded hotel on the island of Fogo, Cape Verde.  With panoramic views of the Atlantic Ocean, neighboring Brava Island, and Fogo’s iconic Caldera, La Fora Ecolodge brings you natural beauty, tranquility and relaxation.  With our focus on sustainability, you can rest easy knowing you have minimized your ecological footprint.
Natural Setting
Bungalows
La Fora Ecolodge is a unique hotel on Fogo, Cape Verde.  We offer the perfect blend of relaxation and natural beauty with your private bungalow overlooking the ocean and iconic volcano.
Our rooms
From the Pool Deck
Relax & Enjoy the View
Cape Verde enjoys an average of 350 days of sunshine a year.  Cool off and chill out in the La Fora Ecolodge dip pool, cleaned by the sun.  You might have to share with the resident grey-crested kingfishers who enjoy a dip as well.
Fresh, Local Food Everyday
La Fora Bar, Lounge & Restaurant
With 180 degree, panoramic views of the Atlantic ocean and countryside, the open-air La Fora Ecolodge Bar, Lounge & Restaurant is open all day for our hotel guests.  Lounge on one of the couches reading your favorite book with a cup of Fogo coffee after breakfast, or spend the afternoon enjoying our signature cocktails with your fellow travelers.  Don’t forget to grab a signature cocktail as the sun sets over Brava, our neighboring island.  At La Fora, we are proud to offer fresh, local food, including vegan and vegetarian options, that celebrates the unique culinary traditions of Cape Verde and Fogo Island, as well as delicious offerings from our pesticide-free gardens.
The Restaurant
Explore Fogo
Rustic, Rural Setting
At La Fora Ecolodge, you will experience the peace and tranquility of small village life in Cape Verde.  Down a meandering path to your private bungalow, take a moment to soak in the views: Brava Island and the Atlantic to the west, the iconic Caldera to the east, and sprawling countryside surrounding you.  Fogo, Cape Verde, is rich with walking and hiking trails, the otherworldly Pico do Fogo, and black sand beaches disappearing into blue waves.  Start your journey to all of these adventures from the rustic beauty of Fogo’s countryside at La Fora.
